label: Deficit
text: Finance Ministry execution data to end-September show a €3.6bn cumulative deficit — 2.8% of projected GDP and roughly half of the €7.2bn planned for 2026 — with revenues of €33.9bn (+11% y/y) against €37.5bn of spending, and some €520mln of the gap opening in September alone; NSI separately booked a €944.4mln general-government deficit for Q2 2026 (3.12% of GDP for the quarter).
